statement: ∀ D : ℕ, 1 ≤ D → (∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 D, (2:ℝ)^d.primeFactors.card) ≤ (D:ℝ)*(1+Real.log D)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Farey 分母对与逆元筛 · HD-8008 · 给整个筛水平的平方自由根数权一个显式总预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Farey denominator pairs and inverse sieve · HD-8008 · Bound the total root weight up to the sieve level

brief.zh: 用 2^ω(d)≤τ(d) 将根权总和限制到除数和，再交换正约数与倍数。用调和和上界 1+log D，供全窗与逆元窗的绝对余项求和。
brief.en: Use 2^ω(d)≤τ(d), then exchange the divisor and multiple sums. The harmonic sum bound 1+log D controls accumulated errors in both the full and inverse-labelled windows.
